services.title: Educational & research domains
services.summary: Institutional domain registration for India’s education and research community.

sections.title: Eligible institutions
sections.body: The guidelines cover institutions recognized, affiliated or registered under central or state laws or education boards, government-affiliated vocational institutions, and research organizations with documentary evidence. They also describe institutions established under societies, trusts, foundations and councils. Eligibility remains subject to the official document review.

sections.title: Eight reserved domain categories
sections.body: ac.in · edu.in · res.in · school.in · alumni.in · विद्या.भारत · शिक्षा.भारत · शोध.भारत. The published guidelines effective 25 August 2025 identify ERNET as their exclusive registrar.

sections.title: Application documents
sections.body: Use the current official checklist: signed institution letter (Annexure A), ₹100 stamp-paper undertaking (Annexure B), admin contact appointment letter, affiliation or recognition evidence, legal registration evidence, and GST documentation where applicable. Research domains need research mandate evidence. Government schools have a separate three-document process.

sections.title: Application process
sections.body: Check availability on the registry portal, complete the declaration and application, upload attested PDFs (maximum 2 MB), and pay through the portal. The guidelines require true copies of the stamp-paper undertaking to reach the Domain Registration Division within 15 days. Renewals also require fresh documents.

sections.title: Domain choice and renewal
sections.body: Names must reflect the institution’s full or abbreviated name. Generic, personal and misleading names are restricted. Initial registration is 1–10 years; the guidelines limit renewal to nine years at a time. These reserved domains cannot transfer to another registrar.

sections.title: Nameservers
sections.body: At least two valid nameservers and a valid DNS entry are required. Institutions may use their own provider or request ERNET DNS services.

services.title: DNS services
services.summary: Domain resolution and nameserver support through the official registry.

sections.title: Configure the domain
sections.body: DNS connects the registered domain to institutional web and mail services. The official guidelines require at least two valid nameservers; an institution can use its own DNS provider or ERNET’s service.

sections.title: Published tariff
sections.body: The tariff lists ERNET DNS at ₹500 + ₹90 GST for the first year and ₹200 + ₹36 GST per year thereafter. Confirm the applicable invoice in the official portal before payment.

sections.title: Manage and get help
sections.body: Configuration changes and renewals belong in the authenticated official domain panel. Email helpdesk@domain.ernet.in to create a support ticket before calling.

services.title: Website as a Service
services.summary: Build an institutional website using ERNET’s templates and content tools.

sections.title: Designed for institutions
sections.body: WaaS provides customizable templates for schools, colleges and universities, with institution branding, drag-and-drop navigation, mobile layouts and a content management system.

sections.title: Hosting and access
sections.body: The portal describes 2 GB per website and SSL-protected HTTPS hosting on ERNET servers. Additional space up to 5 GB is chargeable. Registered domain users access the service through the official portal.

sections.title: Published annual charge
sections.body: The dedicated VAS tariff lists ₹3,800 plus ₹684 GST: ₹4,484 for one year. Longer terms are listed on the portal.

sections.title: Institutional responsibility
sections.body: The institution owns and remains responsible for uploaded content. Payments and publishing are handled on the official service.

services.title: Learning Management as a Service
services.summary: Create a branded learning website for your institution.

sections.title: Learning platform capabilities
sections.body: Published features include customizable branding, a mobile-compatible interface, organized course materials, instructor and learner navigation, multimedia, quizzes and simulations.

sections.title: Service access
sections.body: Registered domain users can create the LMS using portal templates. ERNET describes HTTPS hosting with SSL and 2 GB per website, with additional space up to 5 GB chargeable.

sections.title: Published annual charge
sections.body: The dedicated VAS tariff lists ₹4,300 plus ₹774 GST: ₹5,074 for one year. Confirm subscriptions and payment on the official portal.

services.title: Web hosting & email
services.summary: Published hosting and institutional email support resources.

sections.title: Institutional hosting
sections.body: The official service page describes website hosting for education, academic, research and government organizations, with domain registration handled separately where required.

sections.title: Security review
sections.body: The hosting page requires a security audit before an application is hosted. Consult the latest published hosting guidance and support team for requirements.

sections.title: Technical information
sections.body: The Hindi hosting page contains legacy software versions. They are historical descriptions, not a current compatibility guarantee. Request current platform details from ERNET.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: Web hosting: webhosting@ernet.in. Email support: support@ernet.in. Published service support number: +91 11-22170641.

services.title: Campus Wi-Fi & networking
services.summary: Connect institutional buildings, people and shared resources.

sections.title: Campus network design
sections.body: The official description covers core, distribution and access networks; optical fibre between buildings; copper cabling within buildings; switches, routers, firewalls and intrusion prevention.

sections.title: Campus access
sections.body: Wireless access points and centralized authentication support campus access to institutional applications and internet services. Coverage and equipment requirements depend on the campus.

sections.title: Planning an enquiry
sections.body: Prepare campus layout, buildings, users and existing infrastructure information for a discussion with ERNET. No fixed commercial speed plan is published here.

services.title: eduroam academic roaming
services.summary: Access the official academic roaming service and support.

sections.title: Official service
sections.body: eduroam is linked from ERNET’s service navigation. Use its dedicated portal for institutional participation and configuration information.

sections.title: Support
sections.body: ERNET publishes eduroam@ernet.in and +91 11-22170641. The portal is a JavaScript application; no current participant count or coverage list was verified in this audit.

services.title: ICT consultancy & implementation
services.summary: Institutional planning, project management and technical support.

sections.title: Mandate
sections.body: ERNET’s registry describes consultancy, project management, training and value-added ICT services for education and research institutions.

sections.title: Documented implementation
sections.body: Published projects include campus networks, e-classrooms, accessible government websites and ICT infrastructure. Enquiries should identify the intended beneficiaries, infrastructure and project objectives.

services.title: Terrestrial & satellite connectivity
services.summary: Academic network access and documented satellite connectivity.

sections.title: Academic backbone
sections.body: ERNET describes an MPLS-enabled backbone with IPv4 and IPv6, connecting its points of presence. The published architecture links the VSAT network to the terrestrial network at Bengaluru.

sections.title: Network capabilities
sections.body: The published network page lists IPv4/IPv6 MPLS VPN and multicast capabilities. These are institutional descriptions rather than measured live availability or bandwidth.

sections.title: VSAT support
sections.body: The helpdesk lists Bengaluru VSAT NOC numbers 080-28523004/06/08, toll-free 1800 4253006, and vsathub@eis.ernet.in. Confirm service feasibility directly.

services.title: IPv6 & next-generation networks
services.summary: Dual-stack networking and published IPv6 research resources.

sections.title: IPv6 in the network
sections.body: The ERNET network page documents an IPv4/IPv6 dual-stack backbone and MPLS VPN support.

sections.title: Research and learning
sections.body: Published project resources include Mobile IPv6 and 6LoWPAN. The main website links to the official IPv6 portal. Detailed current consultancy packages were not verified.

services.title: Training & capacity building
services.summary: Networking and ICT knowledge for institutional communities.

sections.title: Areas of activity
sections.body: Published training descriptions cover LAN/WAN, campus networks, next-generation networking, ICT and voice/video conferencing. ERNET describes both internal and external training arrangements.

sections.title: Information security education
sections.body: The ISEA Phase II page documents government-officer capacity building and historical training sessions. It does not establish current enrollment or a new course schedule.

services.status: Published activity; no live enrollment verified

sections.title: School tele-education
sections.body: ERNET’s North Eastern Region project page describes smart virtual classroom infrastructure in 75 schools and four DIETs in Assam and Sikkim. The page records implementation and historical usage.

sections.title: Medical education
sections.body: A separate project describes e-classroom infrastructure in 50 government medical colleges, commissioned in December 2018 for remote medical teaching and collaboration.

sections.title: Project status
sections.body: These figures describe published projects. They are not an offer of a current classroom subscription or live service counters.

services.title: Video conferencing & collaboration
services.summary: Institutional collaboration infrastructure and project experience.

sections.title: Documented systems
sections.body: The project page describes room video conferencing with cameras, microphones, codecs and displays, plus multipoint control where required.

sections.title: Institutional examples
sections.body: Published examples include Uttar Pradesh government offices, Department of Space locations, Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth and the Ministry of Earth Sciences. Treat these as historical project descriptions.

sections.title: Service enquiry
sections.body: Ask ERNET about current institutional collaboration options. This replica does not provide or operate a meeting platform.

services.title: Institutional data centre initiatives
services.summary: Infrastructure projects supporting academic and research institutions.

sections.title: Published ICAR initiative
sections.body: The completed-project directory links a data centre initiative under an ICAR-NAIP agreement supported by World Bank funding. Its description concerns a centralized facility for connected ICAR institutions.

sections.title: Scope
sections.body: ERNET also describes its own hosting infrastructure. These sources do not establish commercial rack, GPU, colocation or general-purpose cloud subscription offerings.

projects.title: E-classrooms for 50 medical colleges
projects.summary: MoHFW selected ERNET as implementing agency. The source records commissioning in December 2018 and remote medical education using video collaboration.
